basic_info.description: Tucked away in a private back building, this top-floor gem offers a peaceful retreat with an impressive, open floor plan that maximizes every square foot. Surrounded by lush greenery, you'll feel miles away from the bustle of the city while still being close to all the essentials. The living room boasts beautiful box beam ceilings, adding character and warmth, while windows on all sides flood the space with natural light. A versatile office room off the living area provides a bright and airy workspace, ideal for remote work or creative projects. The newly remodeled kitchen features modern finishes and ample storage, perfect for both everyday meals and entertaining guests. The quiet bedroom offers a restful sanctuary, complete with hardwood floors throughout the entire condo for a seamless flow. An updated bath with shower completes the home, offering convenience and comfort. Oversized storage room in front building deeded to this unit (1/2 of room)! This unique, tranquil space is perfect for anyone looking to enjoy a peaceful lifestyle while being nestled in the heart of nature.
